title: Crash trend by year - City of Columbus crash layer (all records) (aggregate)
text:
Crash trend 2021-2025 - City of Columbus crash layer (all records), from aggregate counts of Columbus CoC Crash Data.
- City of Columbus crash layer (all records). 2021: 12,033 crashes (81 fatal, 340 serious injury). 2022: 11,876 crashes (68 fatal, 290 serious injury). 2023: 12,947 crashes (68 fatal, 304 serious injury). 2024: 12,625 crashes (49 fatal, 263 serious injury). 2025: 12,703 crashes (51 fatal, 282 serious injury).
Year-to-year differences may partly reflect changes in reporting; the layers do not normalise by traffic volume (VMT) or population.
area: City of Columbus crash layer (all records)
caveats: Derived from aggregate counts; not normalised by exposure.
